mutation.body:
Part of #522. Repairs the first P1 finding in the retained v0.92.1 third-party review.

## Outcome

Retain the failed external report as non-proving evidence, bind the replacement assignment to immutable candidate 9c7e57d412d61898bd44ab00d53e31afbb779e5c, and obtain one independent external review whose assignment, report, limitations, and drift checks all bind that revision.

## Source finding

TPR-001 — Assignment cannot be bound because no candidate SHA was supplied. The reviewer correctly rejected the mutable assignment.

## Deliverables

- Retained failed-review artifact and normalized source metadata under the TAIL-05 evidence root.
- A replacement handoff naming one full 40-character candidate SHA; no inference from main or a working tree.
- Independent reviewer report recording reviewer identity/independence, exact SHA, clean checkout observation, drift result, validation performed, validation omitted, findings, and limitations.
- Candidate-integrity validator with negative cases for missing, malformed, substituted, or assignment/report-mismatched SHA.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] The failed review remains visibly FAIL/non-proving and is never rewritten into a pass.
- [ ] The replacement assignment and report bind the same immutable 40-character SHA.
- [ ] The reviewer confirms clean checkout and no candidate drift.
- [ ] Review limitations and every finding are retained verbatim or through a provenance-preserving normalized record.
- [ ] Focused validator and independent exact-head review pass.

## Dependencies and closure sequencing

- #521 owns the retained external-review report and is closed.
- #833 may freeze and review the explicit candidate while #522 remains administratively open.
- #522 owns all findings returned by #833 and must not close until #833 completes, every new finding is dispositioned, every release blocker is fixed and exactly reviewed, and the final ledger proves the complete denominator.
- Candidate freezing and #522 ledger closure are distinct events; #522 closure is not a prerequisite for freezing this review candidate.

## Non-goals

- Inferring a candidate SHA from the current branch.
- Treating this issue's setup, handoff-only PR, or a failed report as release approval.
- Remediating product findings inside the review artifact.
